import Derive.Flow
import Derive.Backend

/-! Semantics and preservation for the entire structured handler IR. Storage is an explicit
algebra: faults, loads, inserted IDs, and writes are observed in the same order. -/
namespace Derive
open Lean

namespace MeaningF

def map (f : α → β) : MeaningF α → MeaningF β
  | .scalar e => .scalar (f e)
  | .record fs => .record (fs.map fun field => (field.1, map f field.2))
  | .option p m => .option (f p) (map f m)
  | .slist s => .slist s
  | .slistExt s xs => .slistExt s (xs.map (map f))
  | .clist xs => .clist (xs.map (map f))
  | .proof => .proof
  | .absent => .absent
termination_by m => sizeOf m
decreasing_by
  all_goals first | decreasing_tactic | skip
  rename_i h
  have ht := Array.sizeOf_lt_of_mem h
  cases field
  simp_all +arith
  omega

@[simp] theorem map_comp (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (m : MeaningF α) :
    (m.map f).map g = m.map (g ∘ f) := by
  cases m with
  | record fs =>
    simp only [map, Array.map_map]
    congr 1
    apply Array.map_congr_left
    intro field member
    exact congrArg (fun m => (field.1, m)) (map_comp f g field.2)
  | slistExt s xs | clist xs =>
    simp only [map, Array.map_map]
    congr 1
    apply Array.map_congr_left
    intro m member
    exact map_comp f g m
  | option p m => simp only [map, map_comp f g m, Function.comp_apply]
  | _ => simp [map]
termination_by sizeOf m
decreasing_by
  all_goals first | decreasing_tactic | skip
  have ht := Array.sizeOf_lt_of_mem member
  cases field
  simp_all +arith
  omega

end MeaningF

namespace ProgF

def map (f : α → β) : ProgF α → ProgF β
  | .ret m => .ret (m.map f)
  | .fail m => .fail (m.map f)
  | .ite p a b => .ite (f p) (map f a) (map f b)
  | .load row entity id sources k => .load row entity (f id) sources (map f k)
  | .append row source xs k => .append row source (xs.map (MeaningF.map f)) (map f k)
  | .insert n entity m k => .insert n entity (m.map f) (map f k)

end ProgF

namespace Semantics

/-- Decoded native state, independent of the storage engine's representation. -/
structure Machine (Storage : Type) where
  store : Storage
  variables : String → Int
  sources : Nat → List IR.Row
  owners : Nat → Name × Int

/-- The observable storage boundary. A refinement of this algebra is required of an external
storage implementation; the handler lowering theorem quantifies over every such algebra. -/
structure Loaded where
  found : Bool
  columns : IR.Row
  lists : Array (List IR.Row)

structure StorageAlgebra (Storage : Type) where
  load : Storage → Name → Int → Except String Loaded
  append : Storage → (Name × Int) → Nat → Array (MeaningF Int) → Except String Storage
  insert : Storage → Name → MeaningF Int → Except String (Int × Storage)

abbrev Result (Storage : Type) := Except String (Except (MeaningF Int) (MeaningF Int) × Machine Storage)

def bindVariable (w : Machine σ) (name : String) (value : Int) : Machine σ :=
  { w with variables := fun n => if n == name then value else w.variables n }

def afterLoad (w : Machine σ) (row : Nat) (entity : Name) (id : Int)
    (ids : Array Nat) (loaded : Loaded) : Machine σ :=
  let columns := loaded.columns.foldl (fun state (field, value) => bindVariable state s!"row{row}.{field}" value) w
  { bindVariable columns s!"row{row}.found" (if loaded.found then 1 else 0) with
    owners := fun r => if r == row then (entity, id) else w.owners r
    sources := fun s => match ids.idxOf? s with
      | some i => loaded.lists[i]?.getD []
      | none => w.sources s }

def run (scalar : Machine σ → α → Int) (storage : StorageAlgebra σ) : ProgF α → Machine σ → Except String (Except (MeaningF Int) (MeaningF Int) × Machine σ)
  | .ret m, w => .ok (.ok (m.map (scalar w)), w)
  | .fail m, w => .ok (.error (m.map (scalar w)), w)
  | .ite p a b, w => if scalar w p != 0 then run scalar storage a w else run scalar storage b w
  | .load row entity id sources k, w => do
    let loaded ← storage.load w.store entity (scalar w id)
    run scalar storage k (afterLoad w row entity (scalar w id) sources loaded)
  | .append row source xs k, w => do
    let store ← storage.append w.store (w.owners row) source (xs.map (MeaningF.map (scalar w)))
    run scalar storage k { w with store }
  | .insert n entity m k, w => do
    let (id, store) ← storage.insert w.store entity (m.map (scalar w))
    run scalar storage k (bindVariable { w with store } s!"insert{n}.id" id)

/-- Full handler preservation under any scalar lowering that preserves values. This includes
all loads, writes, result/error values, inserted IDs, storage faults, and branch choices. -/
theorem run_map (f : α → β) (a : Machine σ → α → Int) (b : Machine σ → β → Int)
    (h : ∀ w e, b w (f e) = a w e) (storage : StorageAlgebra σ) (p : ProgF α) :
    ∀ w, run b storage (p.map f) w = run a storage p w := by
  have value : ∀ w (m : MeaningF α), (m.map f).map (b w) = m.map (a w) := by
    intro w m
    rw [MeaningF.map_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun g => m.map g) (funext (h w))
  induction p with
  | ret m | fail m => intro w; simp only [ProgF.map, run, value]
  | ite p t e iht ihe => intro w; simp only [ProgF.map, run, h, iht, ihe]
  | load row entity id sources k ih =>
    intro w; simp only [ProgF.map, run, h]
    cases result : storage.load w.store entity (a w id) <;> simp [bind, Except.bind, ih]
  | append row source xs k ih =>
    intro w; simp only [ProgF.map, run, Array.map_map]
    have values : xs.map (MeaningF.map (b w) ∘ MeaningF.map f) = xs.map (MeaningF.map (a w)) := by
      apply Array.map_congr_left; intro m _; exact value w m
  | .record fields => do
    let pairs ← fields.mapM fun (name, value) => do mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[toExpr name, ← quoteMeaning value]
    mkAppM ``MeaningF.record #[← mkArrayLit (← mkAppM ``Prod #[mkConst ``Name, mkConst ``Meaning]) pairs.toList]
  | .option condition value => do mkAppM ``MeaningF.option #[quoteIR condition, ← quoteMeaning value]
  | .slist index => mkAppOptM ``MeaningF.slist #[mkConst ``IR, toExpr index]
  | .slistExt index values => do
    mkAppM ``MeaningF.slistExt #[toExpr index, ← mkArrayLit (mkConst ``Meaning) (← values.mapM quoteMeaning).toList]
  | .clist values => do
    mkAppM ``MeaningF.clist #[← mkArrayLit (mkConst ``Meaning) (← values.mapM quoteMeaning).toList]
  | .proof => mkAppOptM ``MeaningF.proof #[mkConst ``IR]
  | .absent => mkAppOptM ``MeaningF.absent #[mkConst ``IR]

/-- The encoder is determined by the source type, independently of the candidate meaning. -/
partial def encodeValue (source : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType source)
  if ← isProp type then return mkConst ``Source.Value.erased
  if type.isAppOfArity ``List 1 then
    let encoder ← withLocalDeclD `element type.appArg! fun element => do
      mkLambdaFVars #[element] (← encodeValue element)
    return ← mkAppM ``Source.Value.list #[← mkAppM ``Array.map #[encoder, ← mkAppM ``List.toArray #[source]]]
  if type.isAppOfArity ``Option 1 then
    if (← enumCtors? type.appArg!).isNone then
      let encoder ← withLocalDeclD `element type.appArg! fun element => do
        mkLambdaFVars #[element] (← encodeValue element)
      return ← mkAppM ``Source.Value.option #[← mkAppM ``Option.map #[encoder, source]]
  if type.isConstOf ``Nat || type.isConstOf ``Bool || type.isAppOfArity ``Ontology.EntityId 1 ||
      (← enumCtors? type).isSome || type.isAppOfArity ``Option 1 then
    return ← mkAppM ``Source.Value.scalar #[mkApp (← encoding type).code source]
  let .const name _ := type.getAppFn | throwError "derive[source.value_type]: {type}"
  unless isStructure (← getEnv) name do throwError "derive[source.value_type]: {type}"
  let mut fields := #[]
  for field in getStructureFields (← getEnv) name do
    fields := fields.push (← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[toExpr field, ← encodeValue (← mkProjection source field)])
  mkAppM ``Source.Value.record #[← mkArrayLit (← mkAppM ``Prod #[mkConst ``Name, mkConst ``Source.Value]) fields.toList]

def goal (context : SourceReify.Context) (source : Expr) (meaning : Meaning) : MetaM Expr := do
  mkEq (← mkAppM ``Source.denote #[context.world, ← quoteMeaning meaning]) (← encodeValue source)

private def proveUsing (target : Expr) (proofs : Array Expr) (tactic : String) : MetaM Expr := do
  let rec bind (i : Nat) (locals : Array Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
    if h : i < proofs.size then
      let proof := proofs[i]
      withLetDecl (Name.mkSimple s!"source_part_{i}") (← inferType proof) proof fun bindingLocal =>
        bind (i + 1) (locals.push bindingLocal)
    else
      mkLetFVars locals (← prove target ("set_option linter.unnecessarySimpa false in " ++ tactic))
  bind 0 #[]

private def arrayEquality (type : Expr) (equalities : Array Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let mut result ← mkEqRefl (← mkListLit type [])
  let cons := mkApp (mkConst ``List.cons [Level.zero]) type
  for equality in equalities.reverse do
    result ← mkAppM ``congr #[← mkAppM ``congrArg #[cons, equality], result]
  mkAppM ``congrArg #[mkApp (mkConst ``List.toArray [Level.zero]) type, result]

/-- Certify every field and list element, preserving record labels and list order. -/
partial def against (context : SourceReify.Context) (source : Expr) (meaning : Meaning) : MetaM Expr :=
    withOptions (smartUnfolding.set · false) do
  let target ← goal context source meaning
  let proof ← match meaning with
    | .scalar ir => do
      let scalar ← SourceReify.against context source ir
      mkAppM ``Source.denote_scalar #[context.world, (← encoding (← inferType source)).code,
        source, quoteIR ir, ← mkAppM ``Source.ScalarTerm.preserves #[scalar.certificate]]
    | .record fields => do
      let type ← whnfR (← inferType source)
      let .const name _ := type.getAppFn | throwError "derive[source.record]: {type}"
      unless getStructureFields (← getEnv) name == fields.map (·.1) do
        throwError "derive[source.record_fields]: result fields do not match the source record"
      let proofs ← fields.mapM fun (field, value) => do
        let equality ← against context (← mkProjection source field) value
        let pair ← withLocalDeclD `value (mkConst ``Source.Value) fun value => do
          mkLambdaFVars #[value] (← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[toExpr field, value])
        mkAppM ``congrArg #[pair, equality]
      let equality ← arrayEquality (← mkAppM ``Prod #[mkConst ``Name, mkConst ``Source.Value]) proofs
      let constructor ← mkAppM ``Source.denote_record #[context.world, (← quoteMeaning meaning).appArg!,
    let row ← rowEncoding type.appArg!
    let rows ← mkAppM ``Source.World.sources #[context.world, toExpr index]
    let encoded ← mkAppM ``List.map #[row.code, source]
    withLocalDeclD `source_list_relation (← mkEq rows encoded) fun proof => do
      let certificate := mkAppN (mkConst ``Source.StoredList.mk)
        #[row.type, context.world, row.code, source, toExpr index, proof]
      next { context with lists := context.lists.push ⟨source, index, row, certificate⟩ } (hypotheses.push proof)
  | .option condition _ =>
    let type ← whnfR (← inferType source)
    unless type.isAppOfArity ``Option 1 do throwError "derive[source.option_binding]: {type}"
    withBinding context (← mkAppM ``Option.isSome #[source]) (.scalar condition) hypotheses next
  | .proof | .absent => next context hypotheses
  | _ => throwError "derive[source.computed_binding]: only input, storage, and branch bindings may become assumptions"

def certify (name : Name) (source : Expr) (meaning : Meaning)
    (meanings : Std.HashMap FVarId Meaning) : MetaM Name :=
    withTheReader Core.Context (fun context => { context with maxHeartbeats := 10000000000 }) <|
    withOptions (fun options => maxRecDepth.set (maxHeartbeats.set options 10000000) 10000) do
  logInfo m!"certifying source value {name} : {← inferType source}"
  let mut locals := #[]
  let mut bindings := #[]
  for declaration in ← getLCtx do
    unless declaration.isImplementationDetail do
      let value := mkFVar declaration.fvarId
      locals := locals.push value
      if let some meaning := meanings[declaration.fvarId]? then
        bindings := bindings.push (value, meaning)
  withLocalDeclD `source_world (mkConst ``Source.World) fun world => do
    let rec bind (i : Nat) (context : SourceReify.Context) (hypotheses : Array Expr) : MetaM Name := do
      if h : i < bindings.size then
        let (input, meaning) := bindings[i]
        withBinding context input meaning hypotheses (bind (i + 1))
      else
        let proof ← against context source meaning
        let value ← mkLambdaFVars (locals ++ #[world] ++ hypotheses) proof
        unless !value.hasFVar && !value.hasMVar do throwError "derive[source.open_certificate]: unbound proof context"
        let type ← inferType value
        checkWithKernel (mkLet `closed_source_value type value (mkBVar 0))
        if (← getEnv).contains name then
          checkWithKernel (mkLet `existing_source_value type (mkConst name) (mkBVar 0))
        else
          addDecl (.defnDecl { name, levelParams := [], type, value, hints := .abbrev, safety := .safe })
        Codec.auditEvidence (mkConst name)
        return name
    bind 0 { world } #[]

end Derive.SourceValueReify

/-- Decoded native state, independent of the storage engine's representation. -/
structure Machine (Storage : Type) where
  store : Storage
  variables : String → Int
  sources : Nat → List IR.Row
  owners : Nat → Name × Int

/-- The observable storage boundary. A refinement of this algebra is required of an external
storage implementation; the handler lowering theorem quantifies over every such algebra. -/
structure Loaded where
  found : Bool
  columns : IR.Row
  lists : Array (List IR.Row)

structure StorageAlgebra (Storage : Type) where
  load : Storage → Name → Int → Except String Loaded
  append : Storage → (Name × Int) → Nat → Array (MeaningF Int) → Except String Storage
  insert : Storage → Name → MeaningF Int → Except String (Int × Storage)

abbrev Result (Storage : Type) := Except String (Except (MeaningF Int) (MeaningF Int) × Machine Storage)

def bindVariable (w : Machine σ) (name : String) (value : Int) : Machine σ :=
  { w with variables := fun n => if n == name then value else w.variables n }

def afterLoad (w : Machine σ) (row : Nat) (entity : Name) (id : Int)
    (ids : Array Nat) (loaded : Loaded) : Machine σ :=
  let columns := loaded.columns.foldl (fun state (field, value) => bindVariable state s!"row{row}.{field}" value) w
  { bindVariable columns s!"row{row}.found" (if loaded.found then 1 else 0) with
    owners := fun r => if r == row then (entity, id) else w.owners r
    sources := fun s => match ids.idxOf? s with
      | some i => loaded.lists[i]?.getD []
      | none => w.sources s }

def run (scalar : Machine σ → α → Int) (storage : StorageAlgebra σ) : ProgF α → Machine σ → Except String (Except (MeaningF Int) (MeaningF Int) × Machine σ)
  | .ret m, w => .ok (.ok (m.map (scalar w)), w)
  | .fail m, w => .ok (.error (m.map (scalar w)), w)
  | .ite p a b, w => if scalar w p != 0 then run scalar storage a w else run scalar storage b w
  | .load row entity id sources k, w => do
    let loaded ← storage.load w.store entity (scalar w id)
    run scalar storage k (afterLoad w row entity (scalar w id) sources loaded)
  | .append row source xs k, w => do
    let store ← storage.append w.store (w.owners row) source (xs.map (MeaningF.map (scalar w)))
    run scalar storage k { w with store }
  | .insert n entity m k, w => do
    let (id, store) ← storage.insert w.store entity (m.map (scalar w))
    run scalar storage k (bindVariable { w with store } s!"insert{n}.id" id)

/-- Full handler preservation under any scalar lowering that preserves values. This includes

theorem run_map (f : α → β) (a : Machine σ → α → Int) (b : Machine σ → β → Int)
    (h : ∀ w e, b w (f e) = a w e) (storage : StorageAlgebra σ) (p : ProgF α) :

  | ite p t e iht ihe => intro w; simp only [ProgF.map, run, h, iht, ihe]

  let rec bind (i : Nat) (locals : Array Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
    if h : i < proofs.size then

        bind (i + 1) (locals.push bindingLocal)

  let mut result ← mkEqRefl (← mkListLit type [])
  let cons := mkApp (mkConst ``List.cons [Level.zero]) type
  for equality in equalities.reverse do
    result ← mkAppM ``congr #[← mkAppM ``congrArg #[cons, equality], result]

      let constructor ← mkAppM ``Source.denote_record #[context.world, (← quoteMeaning meaning).appArg!,

    let rows ← mkAppM ``Source.World.sources #[context.world, toExpr index]
    let encoded ← mkAppM ``List.map #[row.code, source]

  | _ => throwError "derive[source.computed_binding]: only input, storage, and branch bindings may become assumptions"

def certify (name : Name) (source : Expr) (meaning : Meaning)
    (meanings : Std.HashMap FVarId Meaning) : MetaM Name :=
    withTheReader Core.Context (fun context => { context with maxHeartbeats := 10000000000 }) <|

      let value := mkFVar declaration.fvarId
      locals := locals.push value

import LeanDb.Model
import LeanContract.Operation

/-! # The operation IR

An operation (`Op ε α`, `ReadOp ε α`, `LeanApi.Core.Op`) is a `Flow`: the free monad over
`RequestF`, plus a domain failure channel (`fail`) and decided checks (`check`, behind
`require`). `RequestF` EMBEDS LeanDB's storage requests unchanged (`storage`, any
`LeanDb.Model.StorageRequest`) and adds only the operation-level requests: the clock (`now`)
and authentication (`hashPassword`, `verifyCredential`, `startSession`).

The resource family `Resources` extends LeanDB's `StorageResources` with one slot, `auth`: the
session storage of a profile entity. Model code (`DB`, `Query`) is written against
`portableStorage`, operations against `portableResources`; publication
(`LeanApi.Core.Publish`) generalizes an operation's body over the family, so a native
adapter runs the same body with real evidence. -/

namespace LeanApi.Core
open Ontology LeanDb.Model

/-- The operation layer's resource family: LeanDB's storage evidence, and the session storage
of a profile entity (`auth`, used by `Auth.startSession`). -/
structure Resources extends StorageResources where
  /-- Session storage anchored to the exact profile entity storage. -/
  auth : {T : Type} → entity T → Type 1 := fun _ => PUnit

/-- The portable operation family: no evidence. `Op`/`ReadOp` are written against it. -/
def portableResources : Resources := { toStorageResources := portableStorage, auth := fun _ => PUnit }

/-- Session storage evidence for profile entity `T` on the exact entity storage. -/
class HasAuthResource (family : Resources) (T : Type) (storage : family.entity T) where
  witness : family.auth storage

/- Named, like LeanDB's portable instances: publication abstracts exactly these constants.
The storage is typed at LeanDB's `portableStorage`, which is what `HasEntityResource` hands
out, so instance search matches it without unfolding `portableResources`. -/
instance portableAuth (storage : portableStorage.entity T) : HasAuthResource portableResources T storage :=
  ⟨PUnit.unit⟩

/-- The storage access an operation kind allows: a query reads one snapshot, a command
reads and writes. -/
def accessOf : Contract.OperationKind → Access
  | .query => .query
  | .command => .command

/-- Where an authored credential entity `C` keeps the profile it belongs to and its hash
(generated by `credential C.profileField C.hashField`). -/
structure CredentialLink (C P : Type) where
  identity : String
  profile : FieldPath C (Ref P)
  hash : FieldPath C PasswordHash

/-- One operation-level request. Storage steps are LeanDB's own requests, embedded. -/
inductive RequestF (resources : Resources) (Scope : Type) : Contract.OperationKind → Type → Type 1 where
  /-- The server's clock, sampled by the runtime (after writer admission for a command). -/
  | now {kind : Contract.OperationKind} : RequestF resources Scope kind Instant
  /-- A LeanDB storage request at the access this kind allows. -/
  | storage {kind : Contract.OperationKind} {A : Type}
      (request : StorageRequest resources.toStorageResources Scope (accessOf kind) A) :
      RequestF resources Scope kind A
  /- Authentication (DDD-LAPI-06, decision 4). The runtime prepares the KDF work of
  `hashPassword`/`verifyCredential` before writer admission (`FlowMetadata.kdf` names the
  input field each consumes) and answers them from that preparation in the transaction. -/
  | hashPassword (password : Password) : RequestF resources Scope .command PasswordHash
  /-- Decision 2: `profile = none` still does the (dummy) KDF work and returns `none`. -/
  | verifyCredential {T C : Type} [Entity T] [Entity C] (credentials : resources.entity C)
      (link : CredentialLink C T) (profile : Option (Row Scope T)) (password : Password) :
      RequestF resources Scope .command (Option (Ref T))
  | startSession {T : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (authentication : resources.auth storage)
      (profile : Ref T) : RequestF resources Scope .command Session

abbrev Request (Scope : Type) (kind : Contract.OperationKind) (A : Type)
    (resources : Resources := portableResources) := RequestF resources Scope kind A

/-- The operation language: requests, a closed domain failure channel and decided checks.
A query cannot construct a write request: storage writes exist only at `.command`. -/
inductive FlowF (resources : Resources) (kind : Contract.OperationKind) (Scope Error : Type) : Type → Type 1 where
  | pure {A : Type} (value : A) : FlowF resources kind Scope Error A
  | bind {A B : Type} (value : FlowF resources kind Scope Error A) (next : A → FlowF resources kind Scope Error B) :
      FlowF resources kind Scope Error B
  | fail {A : Type} (error : Error) : FlowF resources kind Scope Error A
  | request {A : Type} (value : RequestF resources Scope kind A) : FlowF resources kind Scope Error A
  | check (proposition : Prop) (decision : Decidable proposition) (error : Error) :
      FlowF resources kind Scope Error (PLift proposition)

abbrev Flow (kind : Contract.OperationKind) (Scope Error A : Type)
    (resources : Resources := portableResources) := FlowF resources kind Scope Error A

namespace Flow
abbrev pure := @FlowF.pure
abbrev bind := @FlowF.bind
abbrev fail := @FlowF.fail
abbrev request := @FlowF.request
abbrev check := @FlowF.check
end Flow

variable {resources : Resources}

instance : Monad (FlowF resources k Scope Error) where
  pure := Flow.pure
  bind := Flow.bind

/-- How a backend answers each request, in monad `m`. Framework failures belong to `m`. -/
structure Algebra (m : Type → Type u) (kind : Contract.OperationKind) (Scope : Type)
    (resources : Resources := portableResources) where
  request : {A : Type} → RequestF resources Scope kind A → m A

/-- The one semantics of an operation: domain failures are `.error`, requests go to the
algebra. -/
def Flow.run {m : Type → Type u} [Monad m] (algebra : Algebra m k Scope resources) :
    Flow k Scope Error A resources → m (Except Error A)
  | .pure value => Pure.pure (.ok value)
  | .fail error => Pure.pure (.error error)
  | .request req => do return .ok (← algebra.request req)
  | .bind value next => do
    match ← Flow.run algebra value with
    | .error error => Pure.pure (.error error)
    | .ok value => Flow.run algebra (next value)
  | .check _ decision error =>
    match decision with
    | .isTrue proof => Pure.pure (.ok ⟨proof⟩)
    | .isFalse _ => Pure.pure (.error error)

abbrev FlowF.run := @Flow.run

/-- A callee's closed error type must be explicitly mapped; new alternatives break the map.
Requests never fail in the domain channel, so only `fail` and `check` change. -/
def Flow.mapError (map : E → F) : Flow k Scope E A resources → Flow k Scope F A resources
  | .pure value => .pure value
  | .fail error => .fail (map error)
  | .bind value next => .bind (Flow.mapError map value) (fun value => Flow.mapError map (next value))
  | .check p decision error => .check p decision (map error)
  | .request req => .request req
abbrev FlowF.mapError := @Flow.mapError

/-- Read requests embed into a writer transaction unchanged. -/
def RequestF.toCommand : RequestF resources Scope .query A → RequestF resources Scope .command A
  | .now => .now
  | .storage req => .storage (kind := .command) req.toCommand

/-- `ReadOp`/`Query` lift into `Op`: the same flow, run inside the writer. -/
def Flow.toCommand : Flow .query Scope E A resources → Flow .command Scope E A resources
  | .pure value => .pure value
  | .fail error => .fail error
  | .bind value next => .bind (Flow.toCommand value) (fun value => Flow.toCommand (next value))
  | .check p decision error => .check p decision error
  | .request req => .request req.toCommand
abbrev FlowF.toCommand := @Flow.toCommand

/-- Capture the domain failures of a flow as values, without a new IR node: every failure
source is structural (`fail`, `check`); requests never fail in the domain channel. -/
def Flow.capture : Flow k Scope E A resources → Flow k Scope E (Except E A) resources
  | .pure value => .pure (.ok value)
  | .fail error => .pure (.error error)
  | .bind value next => .bind (Flow.capture value) fun
      | .ok value => Flow.capture (next value)
      | .error error => .pure (.error error)
  | .check p decision error => match decision with
      | .isTrue proof => .pure (.ok ⟨proof⟩)
      | .isFalse _ => .pure (.error error)
  | .request req => .bind (.request req) (fun value => .pure (.ok value))

/-- `try … catch` for flows: same error type, effects before a caught failure persist. -/
def Flow.tryCatch (body : Flow k Scope E A resources) (handler : E → Flow k Scope E A resources) :
    Flow k Scope E A resources :=
  .bind (Flow.capture body) fun
    | .ok value => .pure value
    | .error error => handler error

/-- One step of a published operation's body, for inspection (`f.operation.metadata.nodes`). -/
structure NodeMetadata where
  kind : String
  effect : Contract.OperationKind
  detail : String
  failure : Option String := none
  fields : List String := []
  constraints : List String := []
  deriving Repr

/-- A KDF step an operation can reach, keyed by the request input field it consumes, so the
runtime can run it before writer admission (decision 4). -/
inductive KdfStep where
  | hash (field : String)
  | verify (field : String)
  deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

structure FlowMetadata where
  identity : Contract.OperationId
  kind : Contract.OperationKind
  failures : List String
  source : String
  actor : String := "Unit"
  nodes : List NodeMetadata := []
  establishesSession : Bool := false
  kdf : List KdfStep := []
  deriving Repr

/-- A published operation: its public wire contract (`Contract.Operation`), the typed
capabilities its body demands, and its body generalized over the family. -/
structure Operation (kind : Contract.OperationKind) (Actor : Type → Type) (Input Output Error : Type) where
  contract : Contract.Operation kind Input Output Error
  Requirements : Resources → Type 1
  portable : Requirements portableResources
  bodyWithResources : {resources : Resources} → Requirements resources →
    {Scope : Type} → Actor Scope → Input → Flow kind Scope Error Output resources
  metadata : FlowMetadata

/-- The body at the portable family (in memory, `LeanApi.Core.Memory`). -/
def Operation.body (operation : Operation kind Actor Input Output Error) :
    {Scope : Type} → Actor Scope → Input → Flow kind Scope Error Output :=
  operation.bodyWithResources operation.portable

/-- Generated only for an input consisting of one nominal route reference. -/
class RouteInput (Input : Type) where
  Target : Type
  targetIdentity : HasTypeId Target
  parse : String → Validation Input
  reference : Input → Ref Target

end LeanApi.Core
import LeanDb.Model.Resources

/-! # The storage-request IR

Every storage step a model program takes is one `StorageRequest`: `find`, `findBy`,
`select` and `linkField` read; `insert`, `update` (whole-record `T.update` and selective
`T.patch` both lower to it, with a `Change`) and `delete` write. A request is indexed by

* the resource family (`StorageResources`): the typed evidence it carries;
* the transaction `Scope`: an uninhabited, rank-2 index rows are tied to;
* its `Access`: reads are polymorphic in it, writes exist only at `.command`. A `.query`
  program cannot contain a write: that is a type error, not a runtime check;
* its answer type.

Declared unique conflicts are VALUES of the entity's own conflict type (`Except C _`); a
foreign-key, restrict or decode failure is the backend's fault, outside the model.

`Program` is the free monad over these requests. `DB` and `Query` (`LeanDb.Model.DB`) are
`Program` at the portable family. A backend runs a program with an `Interpreter`; the
in-memory backend (`LeanDb.Model.Memory`) and SQLite (`LeanDb.Native`) interpret the same
requests. A larger monad (an operation IR) embeds programs with `Program.run`, or with
`Program.lift` given a `MonadStorage` instance. -/

namespace LeanDb.Model
open Ontology

/-- What a program may do: `query` reads one snapshot, `command` reads and writes. -/
inductive Access where
  | query
  | command
  deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

/-- Transaction index of model programs. Uninhabited and never inspected: a backend
replaces it by its own rank-2 `Scope`, so rows cannot depend on it. -/
inductive OpScope : Type

/-- A stored row: its identity and its value, read in transaction `Scope`. Interpreter-local
data: no `Wire` instance, no public constructor. -/
structure Row (Scope T : Type) where
  private mk ::
  id : Ref T
  value : T

instance {Scope T : Type} : CoeOut (Row Scope T) T := ⟨@Row.value Scope T⟩

/- Explicitly trusted assembly boundary: interpreters build rows only after a live lookup in
the current snapshot or transaction. -/
namespace Trusted
def row (id : Ref T) (value : T) : Row Scope T := ⟨id, value⟩
end Trusted

/-- One storage step. See the module documentation. -/
inductive StorageRequest (resources : StorageResources) (Scope : Type) : Access → Type → Type 1 where
  /-- The row with this identity, if it exists. -/
  | find {T : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (id : Ref T) :
      StorageRequest resources Scope access (Option (Row Scope T))
  /-- The row whose declared unique key is `key`, if it exists. -/
  | findBy {T K : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (unique : UniqueKey T K)
      (lookup : resources.unique storage unique) (key : K) :
      StorageRequest resources Scope access (Option (Row Scope T))
  /-- Every row, by identity. -/
  | select {T : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) :
      StorageRequest resources Scope access (List (Row Scope T))
  /-- A join projection: field `field` of every target `T` linked to `parent` through edge
  `E`, each target once, ordered by target identity. -/
  | linkField {E P T V : Type} [Entity E] [Entity T] (edges : resources.entity E) (key : LinkKey E P T)
      (link : resources.link edges key) (targets : resources.entity T) (field : FieldPath T V)
      (column : resources.column targets field) (parent : Ref P) :
      StorageRequest resources Scope access (List V)
  /-- Insert a row. A clash with one of `conflicts` is `.error` of its `publicFailure`, and
  writes nothing. -/
  | insert {T C : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (value : T)
      (conflicts : List (Constraint C)) : StorageRequest resources Scope .command (Except C (Ref T))
  /-- Apply `patch` to the live row. Only constraints over fields whose value changes are
  checked (touched-field rule); a clash is `.error` and writes nothing. -/
  | update {T C : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (row : Row Scope T) (patch : Change T)
      (conflicts : List (Constraint C)) : StorageRequest resources Scope .command (Except C Unit)
  /-- Delete the row. A row still referenced (and not cascaded) is the backend's fault. -/
  | delete {T : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (row : Row Scope T) :
      StorageRequest resources Scope .command Unit

/-- Read requests run unchanged inside a writer. -/
def StorageRequest.toCommand {resources : StorageResources} {Scope A : Type} :
    StorageRequest resources Scope .query A → StorageRequest resources Scope .command A
  | @StorageRequest.find _ _ _ T inst storage id => @StorageRequest.find _ _ _ T inst storage id
  | @StorageRequest.findBy _ _ _ T K inst storage unique lookup key =>
      @StorageRequest.findBy _ _ _ T K inst storage unique lookup key
  | @StorageRequest.select _ _ _ T inst storage => @StorageRequest.select _ _ _ T inst storage
  | @StorageRequest.linkField _ _ _ E P T V instE instT edges key link targets field column parent =>
      @StorageRequest.linkField _ _ _ E P T V instE instT edges key link targets field column parent

/-- A model program: the free monad over `StorageRequest`. -/
inductive Program (resources : StorageResources) (access : Access) (Scope : Type) : Type → Type 1 where
  | pure {A : Type} (value : A) : Program resources access Scope A
  | bind {A B : Type} (value : Program resources access Scope A) (next : A → Program resources access Scope B) :
      Program resources access Scope B
  | request {A : Type} (value : StorageRequest resources Scope access A) : Program resources access Scope A

instance {resources : StorageResources} {access : Access} {Scope : Type} : Monad (Program resources access Scope) where
  pure := Program.pure
  bind := Program.bind

/-- A read program runs unchanged inside a writer. -/
def Program.toCommand {resources : StorageResources} {Scope : Type} :
    {A : Type} → Program resources .query Scope A → Program resources .command Scope A
  | _, .pure value => .pure value
  | _, .bind value next => .bind (Program.toCommand value) (fun result => Program.toCommand (next result))
  | _, .request req => .request req.toCommand

/-- A backend: how each storage request runs in monad `m`. LeanDB implements it in memory
(`LeanDb.Model.Memory.interpreter`) and on SQLite (`LeanDb.Native.commandInterpreter`,
`LeanDb.Native.queryInterpreter`). Framework failures belong to `m`. -/
structure Interpreter (m : Type → Type u) (resources : StorageResources) (access : Access) (Scope : Type) where
  request : {A : Type} → StorageRequest resources Scope access A → m A

/-- A command interpreter also answers read requests. -/
def Interpreter.toQuery {m : Type → Type u} {resources : StorageResources} {Scope : Type}
    (interpreter : Interpreter m resources .command Scope) : Interpreter m resources .query Scope :=
  ⟨fun req => interpreter.request req.toCommand⟩

/-- Run a program with an interpreter. The one semantics of a model program. -/
def Program.run {m : Type → Type u} [Monad m] {resources : StorageResources} {access : Access} {Scope : Type}
    (interpreter : Interpreter m resources access Scope) : {A : Type} → Program resources access Scope A → m A
  | _, .pure value => Pure.pure value
  | _, .bind value next => do Program.run interpreter (next (← Program.run interpreter value))
  | _, .request req => interpreter.request req

/-- A monad that can perform the storage requests of family `resources` at `access`: how an
operation IR embeds model programs (`instance : MonadStorage … (Op ε)` gives
`MonadLift DB (Op ε)`). -/
class MonadStorage (resources : StorageResources) (access : Access) (Scope : Type) (m : Type → Type u) where
  storage : {A : Type} → StorageRequest resources Scope access A → m A

/-- Embed a program into a `MonadStorage` monad, request by request. -/
def Program.lift {m : Type → Type u} [Monad m] {resources : StorageResources} {access : Access} {Scope : Type}
    [MonadStorage resources access Scope m] {A : Type} (program : Program resources access Scope A) : m A :=
  program.run ⟨MonadStorage.storage⟩

end LeanDb.Model
import Derive.Semantics
import Derive.SourceSemantics
import Derive.RowProofs

namespace Derive.Source
open Lean

/-- Canonicalize branch polarity when comparing independently reified expressions. -/
def branchForm : IR → IR
  | .ite condition yes no =>
    match branchForm condition with
    | .not condition => .ite condition (branchForm no) (branchForm yes)
    | condition => .ite condition (branchForm yes) (branchForm no)
  | .found source predicate => .found source (branchForm predicate)
  | .find source predicate field => .find source (branchForm predicate) field
  | .eq a b => .eq (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .lt a b => .lt (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .and a b => .and (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .or a b => .or (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .not a => .not (branchForm a)
  | .add a b => .add (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .sub a b => .sub (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .mod a b => .mod (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | e => e

theorem branchForm_sound (variables : String → Int) (sources : Nat → List IR.Row)
    (expression : IR) : ∀ rows,
    IR.evalRows variables sources rows (branchForm expression) = IR.evalRows variables sources rows expression := by
  induction expression with
  | ite condition yes no hc hy hn =>
    intro rows
    simp only [branchForm]
    split
    next c h =>
      have he := hc rows
      rw [h] at he
      simp only [IR.evalRows] at he ⊢
      rw [← he, hy, hn]
      by_cases hzero : IR.evalRows variables sources rows c = 0 <;> simp [hzero]
    next c h => simp only [IR.evalRows, hc, hy, hn]
  | found source predicate ih | find source predicate field ih =>
    intro rows
    simp only [branchForm, IR.evalRows, ih]
  | _ => intro rows; simp_all [branchForm, IR.evalRows]

structure World where
  variables : String → Int
  sources : Nat → List IR.Row
  rows : List IR.Row

def World.push (world : World) (row : IR.Row) : World :=
  { world with rows := row :: world.rows }

/-- A stored-list binding relates the actual typed source list to the decoded rows. -/
structure StoredList {α : Type} (world : World) (encode : α → IR.Row) (source : List α) where
  index : Nat
  preserves : world.sources index = source.map encode

inductive Value where
  | scalar (value : Int)
  | record (fields : Array (Name × Value))
  | option (value : Option Value)
  | list (values : Array Value)
  | erased
  deriving Repr, BEq

def rowValue (row : IR.Row) : Value :=
  .record (row.toArray.map fun (name, value) => (Name.mkSimple name, .scalar value))

def denote (world : World) : Meaning → Value
  | .scalar e => .scalar (IR.evalRows world.variables world.sources world.rows e)
  | .record fields => .record (fields.map fun field => (field.1, denote world field.2))
  | .option condition value => .option (if IR.evalRows world.variables world.sources world.rows condition != 0 then some (denote world value) else none)
  | .slist source => .list ((world.sources source).toArray.map rowValue)
  | .slistExt source extra => .list ((world.sources source).toArray.map rowValue ++ extra.map (denote world))
  | .clist values => .list (values.map (denote world))
  | .proof | .absent => .erased
termination_by value => sizeOf value
decreasing_by
  all_goals first | decreasing_tactic | skip
  rename_i member
  have h := Array.sizeOf_lt_of_mem member
  cases field
  simp_all +arith
  omega

abbrev Encoder (α : Type) := α → Value

def Realizes (world : World) (encode : Encoder α) (meaning : Meaning) (source : α) : Prop :=
  denote world meaning = encode source

def boolCode (value : Bool) : Int := if value then 1 else 0

@[simp] theorem boolCode_ne_zero (value : Bool) : (boolCode value != 0) = value := by cases value <;> rfl

structure ScalarEncoder (α : Type) where
  code : α → Int
  nonnegative : ∀ value, 0 ≤ code value
  injective : Function.Injective code

def ScalarEncoder.option (encode : ScalarEncoder α) : Option α → Int
  | none => -1
  | some value => encode.code value

theorem ScalarEncoder.option_injective (encode : ScalarEncoder α) :
    Function.Injective encode.option := by
  intro a b h
  cases a with
  | none =>
    cases b with
    | none => rfl
    | some value => have := encode.nonnegative value; simp only [option] at h; omega
  | some value =>
    cases b with
    | none => have := encode.nonnegative value; simp only [option] at h; omega
    | some other => exact congrArg some (encode.injective h)

theorem ScalarEncoder.eq_iff (encode : ScalarEncoder α) (a b : α) :
    encode.code a = encode.code b ↔ a = b := ⟨fun h => encode.injective h, congrArg encode.code⟩

def natural : ScalarEncoder Nat := ⟨Int.ofNat, Int.natCast_nonneg, by intro a b h; exact Int.ofNat.inj h⟩

def boolean : ScalarEncoder Bool :=
  ⟨boolCode, by intro value; cases value <;> decide,
    by intro a b h; cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [boolCode]⟩

/-- The primitive recognizer's equality obligation uses injective encoding, rather than
assuming that two constructor numbers represent the same nominal type. -/
theorem equality (encode : ScalarEncoder α) [DecidableEq α] (a b : α) :
    (if encode.code a == encode.code b then (1 : Int) else 0) = boolCode (decide (a = b)) := by

and authentication (`hashPassword`, `verifyCredential`, `startSession`).

session storage of a profile entity. Model code (`DB`, `Query`) is written against

namespace LeanApi.Core
open Ontology LeanDb.Model

/-- The operation layer's resource family: LeanDB's storage evidence, and the session storage
of a profile entity (`auth`, used by `Auth.startSession`). -/
structure Resources extends StorageResources where
  /-- Session storage anchored to the exact profile entity storage. -/
  auth : {T : Type} → entity T → Type 1 := fun _ => PUnit

/-- The portable operation family: no evidence. `Op`/`ReadOp` are written against it. -/
def portableResources : Resources := { toStorageResources := portableStorage, auth := fun _ => PUnit }

/-- Session storage evidence for profile entity `T` on the exact entity storage. -/
class HasAuthResource (family : Resources) (T : Type) (storage : family.entity T) where
  witness : family.auth storage

/- Named, like LeanDB's portable instances: publication abstracts exactly these constants.
The storage is typed at LeanDB's `portableStorage`, which is what `HasEntityResource` hands
out, so instance search matches it without unfolding `portableResources`. -/
instance portableAuth (storage : portableStorage.entity T) : HasAuthResource portableResources T storage :=
  ⟨PUnit.unit⟩

/-- The storage access an operation kind allows: a query reads one snapshot, a command
reads and writes. -/
def accessOf : Contract.OperationKind → Access
  | .query => .query
  | .command => .command

/-- Where an authored credential entity `C` keeps the profile it belongs to and its hash
(generated by `credential C.profileField C.hashField`). -/
structure CredentialLink (C P : Type) where
  identity : String
  profile : FieldPath C (Ref P)
  hash : FieldPath C PasswordHash

/-- One operation-level request. Storage steps are LeanDB's own requests, embedded. -/
inductive RequestF (resources : Resources) (Scope : Type) : Contract.OperationKind → Type → Type 1 where
  /-- The server's clock, sampled by the runtime (after writer admission for a command). -/
  | now {kind : Contract.OperationKind} : RequestF resources Scope kind Instant
  /-- A LeanDB storage request at the access this kind allows. -/
  | storage {kind : Contract.OperationKind} {A : Type}
      (request : StorageRequest resources.toStorageResources Scope (accessOf kind) A) :
      RequestF resources Scope kind A
  /- Authentication (DDD-LAPI-06, decision 4). The runtime prepares the KDF work of
  `hashPassword`/`verifyCredential` before writer admission (`FlowMetadata.kdf` names the
  input field each consumes) and answers them from that preparation in the transaction. -/
  | hashPassword (password : Password) : RequestF resources Scope .command PasswordHash
  /-- Decision 2: `profile = none` still does the (dummy) KDF work and returns `none`. -/
  | verifyCredential {T C : Type} [Entity T] [Entity C] (credentials : resources.entity C)
      (link : CredentialLink C T) (profile : Option (Row Scope T)) (password : Password) :
      RequestF resources Scope .command (Option (Ref T))
  | startSession {T : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (authentication : resources.auth storage)
      (profile : Ref T) : RequestF resources Scope .command Session

abbrev Request (Scope : Type) (kind : Contract.OperationKind) (A : Type)
    (resources : Resources := portableResources) := RequestF resources Scope kind A

/-- The operation language: requests, a closed domain failure channel and decided checks.
A query cannot construct a write request: storage writes exist only at `.command`. -/
inductive FlowF (resources : Resources) (kind : Contract.OperationKind) (Scope Error : Type) : Type → Type 1 where
  | pure {A : Type} (value : A) : FlowF resources kind Scope Error A
  | bind {A B : Type} (value : FlowF resources kind Scope Error A) (next : A → FlowF resources kind Scope Error B) :
      FlowF resources kind Scope Error B
  | fail {A : Type} (error : Error) : FlowF resources kind Scope Error A
  | request {A : Type} (value : RequestF resources Scope kind A) : FlowF resources kind Scope Error A
  | check (proposition : Prop) (decision : Decidable proposition) (error : Error) :
      FlowF resources kind Scope Error (PLift proposition)

abbrev Flow (kind : Contract.OperationKind) (Scope Error A : Type)
    (resources : Resources := portableResources) := FlowF resources kind Scope Error A

namespace Flow
abbrev pure := @FlowF.pure
abbrev bind := @FlowF.bind
abbrev fail := @FlowF.fail
abbrev request := @FlowF.request
abbrev check := @FlowF.check
end Flow

variable {resources : Resources}

instance : Monad (FlowF resources k Scope Error) where
  pure := Flow.pure
  bind := Flow.bind

/-- How a backend answers each request, in monad `m`. Framework failures belong to `m`. -/
structure Algebra (m : Type → Type u) (kind : Contract.OperationKind) (Scope : Type)
    (resources : Resources := portableResources) where
  request : {A : Type} → RequestF resources Scope kind A → m A

/-- The one semantics of an operation: domain failures are `.error`, requests go to the
algebra. -/
def Flow.run {m : Type → Type u} [Monad m] (algebra : Algebra m k Scope resources) :
    Flow k Scope Error A resources → m (Except Error A)
  | .pure value => Pure.pure (.ok value)
  | .fail error => Pure.pure (.error error)
  | .request req => do return .ok (← algebra.request req)
  | .bind value next => do
    match ← Flow.run algebra value with
    | .error error => Pure.pure (.error error)
    | .ok value => Flow.run algebra (next value)
  | .check _ decision error =>
    match decision with
    | .isTrue proof => Pure.pure (.ok ⟨proof⟩)
    | .isFalse _ => Pure.pure (.error error)

abbrev FlowF.run := @Flow.run

/-- A callee's closed error type must be explicitly mapped; new alternatives break the map.
Requests never fail in the domain channel, so only `fail` and `check` change. -/
def Flow.mapError (map : E → F) : Flow k Scope E A resources → Flow k Scope F A resources
  | .pure value => .pure value
  | .fail error => .fail (map error)
  | .bind value next => .bind (Flow.mapError map value) (fun value => Flow.mapError map (next value))
  | .check p decision error => .check p decision (map error)
  | .request req => .request req
abbrev FlowF.mapError := @Flow.mapError

/-- Read requests embed into a writer transaction unchanged. -/
def RequestF.toCommand : RequestF resources Scope .query A → RequestF resources Scope .command A
  | .now => .now
  | .storage req => .storage (kind := .command) req.toCommand

/-- `ReadOp`/`Query` lift into `Op`: the same flow, run inside the writer. -/
def Flow.toCommand : Flow .query Scope E A resources → Flow .command Scope E A resources
  | .pure value => .pure value
  | .fail error => .fail error
  | .bind value next => .bind (Flow.toCommand value) (fun value => Flow.toCommand (next value))
  | .check p decision error => .check p decision error
  | .request req => .request req.toCommand
abbrev FlowF.toCommand := @Flow.toCommand

/-- Capture the domain failures of a flow as values, without a new IR node: every failure
source is structural (`fail`, `check`); requests never fail in the domain channel. -/
def Flow.capture : Flow k Scope E A resources → Flow k Scope E (Except E A) resources
  | .pure value => .pure (.ok value)
  | .fail error => .pure (.error error)
  | .bind value next => .bind (Flow.capture value) fun
      | .ok value => Flow.capture (next value)
      | .error error => .pure (.error error)
  | .check p decision error => match decision with
      | .isTrue proof => .pure (.ok ⟨proof⟩)
      | .isFalse _ => .pure (.error error)
  | .request req => .bind (.request req) (fun value => .pure (.ok value))

/-- `try … catch` for flows: same error type, effects before a caught failure persist. -/
def Flow.tryCatch (body : Flow k Scope E A resources) (handler : E → Flow k Scope E A resources) :
    Flow k Scope E A resources :=
  .bind (Flow.capture body) fun
    | .ok value => .pure value
    | .error error => handler error

/-- One step of a published operation's body, for inspection (`f.operation.metadata.nodes`). -/
structure NodeMetadata where
  kind : String
  effect : Contract.OperationKind
  detail : String
  failure : Option String := none

import LeanDb.Model.Resources

/-! # The storage-request IR

Every storage step a model program takes is one `StorageRequest`: `find`, `findBy`,
`select` and `linkField` read; `insert`, `update` (whole-record `T.update` and selective
`T.patch` both lower to it, with a `Change`) and `delete` write. A request is indexed by

* the resource family (`StorageResources`): the typed evidence it carries;
* the transaction `Scope`: an uninhabited, rank-2 index rows are tied to;
* its `Access`: reads are polymorphic in it, writes exist only at `.command`. A `.query`
  program cannot contain a write: that is a type error, not a runtime check;
* its answer type.

Declared unique conflicts are VALUES of the entity's own conflict type (`Except C _`); a
foreign-key, restrict or decode failure is the backend's fault, outside the model.

`Program` is the free monad over these requests. `DB` and `Query` (`LeanDb.Model.DB`) are
`Program` at the portable family. A backend runs a program with an `Interpreter`; the
in-memory backend (`LeanDb.Model.Memory`) and SQLite (`LeanDb.Native`) interpret the same
requests. A larger monad (an operation IR) embeds programs with `Program.run`, or with
`Program.lift` given a `MonadStorage` instance. -/

namespace LeanDb.Model
open Ontology

/-- What a program may do: `query` reads one snapshot, `command` reads and writes. -/
inductive Access where
  | query
  | command
  deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

/-- Transaction index of model programs. Uninhabited and never inspected: a backend
replaces it by its own rank-2 `Scope`, so rows cannot depend on it. -/
inductive OpScope : Type

/-- A stored row: its identity and its value, read in transaction `Scope`. Interpreter-local
data: no `Wire` instance, no public constructor. -/
structure Row (Scope T : Type) where
  private mk ::
  id : Ref T
  value : T

instance {Scope T : Type} : CoeOut (Row Scope T) T := ⟨@Row.value Scope T⟩

/- Explicitly trusted assembly boundary: interpreters build rows only after a live lookup in
the current snapshot or transaction. -/
namespace Trusted
def row (id : Ref T) (value : T) : Row Scope T := ⟨id, value⟩
end Trusted

/-- One storage step. See the module documentation. -/
inductive StorageRequest (resources : StorageResources) (Scope : Type) : Access → Type → Type 1 where
  /-- The row with this identity, if it exists. -/
  | find {T : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (id : Ref T) :
      StorageRequest resources Scope access (Option (Row Scope T))
  /-- The row whose declared unique key is `key`, if it exists. -/
  | findBy {T K : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (unique : UniqueKey T K)
      (lookup : resources.unique storage unique) (key : K) :
      StorageRequest resources Scope access (Option (Row Scope T))
  /-- Every row, by identity. -/
  | select {T : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) :
      StorageRequest resources Scope access (List (Row Scope T))
  /-- A join projection: field `field` of every target `T` linked to `parent` through edge
  `E`, each target once, ordered by target identity. -/
  | linkField {E P T V : Type} [Entity E] [Entity T] (edges : resources.entity E) (key : LinkKey E P T)
      (link : resources.link edges key) (targets : resources.entity T) (field : FieldPath T V)
      (column : resources.column targets field) (parent : Ref P) :
      StorageRequest resources Scope access (List V)
  /-- Insert a row. A clash with one of `conflicts` is `.error` of its `publicFailure`, and
  writes nothing. -/
  | insert {T C : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (value : T)
      (conflicts : List (Constraint C)) : StorageRequest resources Scope .command (Except C (Ref T))
  /-- Apply `patch` to the live row. Only constraints over fields whose value changes are
  checked (touched-field rule); a clash is `.error` and writes nothing. -/
  | update {T C : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (row : Row Scope T) (patch : Change T)
      (conflicts : List (Constraint C)) : StorageRequest resources Scope .command (Except C Unit)
  /-- Delete the row. A row still referenced (and not cascaded) is the backend's fault. -/
  | delete {T : Type} [Entity T] (storage : resources.entity T) (row : Row Scope T) :
      StorageRequest resources Scope .command Unit

/-- Read requests run unchanged inside a writer. -/
def StorageRequest.toCommand {resources : StorageResources} {Scope A : Type} :
    StorageRequest resources Scope .query A → StorageRequest resources Scope .command A
  | @StorageRequest.find _ _ _ T inst storage id => @StorageRequest.find _ _ _ T inst storage id
  | @StorageRequest.findBy _ _ _ T K inst storage unique lookup key =>
      @StorageRequest.findBy _ _ _ T K inst storage unique lookup key
  | @StorageRequest.select _ _ _ T inst storage => @StorageRequest.select _ _ _ T inst storage
  | @StorageRequest.linkField _ _ _ E P T V instE instT edges key link targets field column parent =>
      @StorageRequest.linkField _ _ _ E P T V instE instT edges key link targets field column parent

/-- A model program: the free monad over `StorageRequest`. -/
inductive Program (resources : StorageResources) (access : Access) (Scope : Type) : Type → Type 1 where
  | pure {A : Type} (value : A) : Program resources access Scope A
  | bind {A B : Type} (value : Program resources access Scope A) (next : A → Program resources access Scope B) :
      Program resources access Scope B
  | request {A : Type} (value : StorageRequest resources Scope access A) : Program resources access Scope A

instance {resources : StorageResources} {access : Access} {Scope : Type} : Monad (Program resources access Scope) where
  pure := Program.pure
  bind := Program.bind

/-- A read program runs unchanged inside a writer. -/
def Program.toCommand {resources : StorageResources} {Scope : Type} :
    {A : Type} → Program resources .query Scope A → Program resources .command Scope A
  | _, .pure value => .pure value
  | _, .bind value next => .bind (Program.toCommand value) (fun result => Program.toCommand (next result))
  | _, .request req => .request req.toCommand

/-- A backend: how each storage request runs in monad `m`. LeanDB implements it in memory
(`LeanDb.Model.Memory.interpreter`) and on SQLite (`LeanDb.Native.commandInterpreter`,
`LeanDb.Native.queryInterpreter`). Framework failures belong to `m`. -/
structure Interpreter (m : Type → Type u) (resources : StorageResources) (access : Access) (Scope : Type) where
  request : {A : Type} → StorageRequest resources Scope access A → m A

/-- A command interpreter also answers read requests. -/
def Interpreter.toQuery {m : Type → Type u} {resources : StorageResources} {Scope : Type}
    (interpreter : Interpreter m resources .command Scope) : Interpreter m resources .query Scope :=
  ⟨fun req => interpreter.request req.toCommand⟩

/-- Run a program with an interpreter. The one semantics of a model program. -/
def Program.run {m : Type → Type u} [Monad m] {resources : StorageResources} {access : Access} {Scope : Type}
    (interpreter : Interpreter m resources access Scope) : {A : Type} → Program resources access Scope A → m A
  | _, .pure value => Pure.pure value
  | _, .bind value next => do Program.run interpreter (next (← Program.run interpreter value))
  | _, .request req => interpreter.request req

/-- A monad that can perform the storage requests of family `resources` at `access`: how an
operation IR embeds model programs (`instance : MonadStorage … (Op ε)` gives
`MonadLift DB (Op ε)`). -/
class MonadStorage (resources : StorageResources) (access : Access) (Scope : Type) (m : Type → Type u) where
  storage : {A : Type} → StorageRequest resources Scope access A → m A

/-- Embed a program into a `MonadStorage` monad, request by request. -/
def Program.lift {m : Type → Type u} [Monad m] {resources : StorageResources} {access : Access} {Scope : Type}
    [MonadStorage resources access Scope m] {A : Type} (program : Program resources access Scope A) : m A :=
  program.run ⟨MonadStorage.storage⟩

end LeanDb.Model

namespace Derive.Source
open Lean

/-- Canonicalize branch polarity when comparing independently reified expressions. -/
def branchForm : IR → IR
  | .ite condition yes no =>
    match branchForm condition with
    | .not condition => .ite condition (branchForm no) (branchForm yes)
    | condition => .ite condition (branchForm yes) (branchForm no)
  | .found source predicate => .found source (branchForm predicate)
  | .find source predicate field => .find source (branchForm predicate) field
  | .eq a b => .eq (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .lt a b => .lt (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .and a b => .and (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .or a b => .or (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .not a => .not (branchForm a)
  | .add a b => .add (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .sub a b => .sub (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | .mod a b => .mod (branchForm a) (branchForm b)
  | e => e

theorem branchForm_sound (variables : String → Int) (sources : Nat → List IR.Row)
    (expression : IR) : ∀ rows,
    IR.evalRows variables sources rows (branchForm expression) = IR.evalRows variables sources rows expression := by
  induction expression with
  | ite condition yes no hc hy hn =>
    intro rows
    simp only [branchForm]
    split
    next c h =>
      have he := hc rows
      rw [h] at he
      simp only [IR.evalRows] at he ⊢
      rw [← he, hy, hn]
      by_cases hzero : IR.evalRows variables sources rows c = 0 <;> simp [hzero]
    next c h => simp only [IR.evalRows, hc, hy, hn]
  | found source predicate ih | find source predicate field ih =>
    intro rows
    simp only [branchForm, IR.evalRows, ih]
  | _ => intro rows; simp_all [branchForm, IR.evalRows]

structure World where
  variables : String → Int
  sources : Nat → List IR.Row
  rows : List IR.Row

def World.push (world : World) (row : IR.Row) : World :=
  { world with rows := row :: world.rows }

/-- A stored-list binding relates the actual typed source list to the decoded rows. -/
structure StoredList {α : Type} (world : World) (encode : α → IR.Row) (source : List α) where
  index : Nat
  preserves : world.sources index = source.map encode

inductive Value where
  | scalar (value : Int)
  | record (fields : Array (Name × Value))
  | option (value : Option Value)
  | list (values : Array Value)
  | erased
  deriving Repr, BEq

def rowValue (row : IR.Row) : Value :=
  .record (row.toArray.map fun (name, value) => (Name.mkSimple name, .scalar value))

def denote (world : World) : Meaning → Value
  | .scalar e => .scalar (IR.evalRows world.variables world.sources world.rows e)
  | .record fields => .record (fields.map fun field => (field.1, denote world field.2))
  | .option condition value => .option (if IR.evalRows world.variables world.sources world.rows condition != 0 then some (denote world value) else none)
  | .slist source => .list ((world.sources source).toArray.map rowValue)
  | .slistExt source extra => .list ((world.sources source).toArray.map rowValue ++ extra.map (denote world))
  | .clist values => .list (values.map (denote world))
  | .proof | .absent => .erased
termination_by value => sizeOf value
decreasing_by
  all_goals first | decreasing_tactic | skip
  rename_i member
  have h := Array.sizeOf_lt_of_mem member
  cases field
  simp_all +arith
  omega

abbrev Encoder (α : Type) := α → Value

def Realizes (world : World) (encode : Encoder α) (meaning : Meaning) (source : α) : Prop :=
  denote world meaning = encode source

def boolCode (value : Bool) : Int := if value then 1 else 0

@[simp] theorem boolCode_ne_zero (value : Bool) : (boolCode value != 0) = value := by cases value <;> rfl

structure ScalarEncoder (α : Type) where
  code : α → Int
  nonnegative : ∀ value, 0 ≤ code value
  injective : Function.Injective code

def ScalarEncoder.option (encode : ScalarEncoder α) : Option α → Int
  | none => -1
  | some value => encode.code value

theorem ScalarEncoder.option_injective (encode : ScalarEncoder α) :
    Function.Injective encode.option := by
  intro a b h
  cases a with
  | none =>
    cases b with
    | none => rfl
    | some value => have := encode.nonnegative value; simp only [option] at h; omega
  | some value =>
    cases b with
    | none => have := encode.nonnegative value; simp only [option] at h; omega
    | some other => exact congrArg some (encode.injective h)

theorem ScalarEncoder.eq_iff (encode : ScalarEncoder α) (a b : α) :
    encode.code a = encode.code b ↔ a = b := ⟨fun h => encode.injective h, congrArg encode.code⟩

def natural : ScalarEncoder Nat := ⟨Int.ofNat, Int.natCast_nonneg, by intro a b h; exact Int.ofNat.inj h⟩

def boolean : ScalarEncoder Bool :=
  ⟨boolCode, by intro value; cases value <;> decide,
    by intro a b h; cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [boolCode]⟩

/-- The primitive recognizer's equality obligation uses injective encoding, rather than
assuming that two constructor numbers represent the same nominal type. -/
theorem equality (encode : ScalarEncoder α) [DecidableEq α] (a b : α) :

import LeanDb.Model
import LeanApi.Core
import TicTacToe.Rules
open LeanDb.Model LeanApi.Core TicTacToe

/-! The API server: storage and endpoints for the rules in `TicTacToe.Rules`. -/

deriving instance Domain for Player, Square, Move, Status

/-- A board is stored and sent as its moves, and read back by replaying them. -/
represent Board as List Move by (·.moves) checked Board.replay

structure Game where
  board : Board
  deriving Entity

def newGame : Op Empty (Ref Game) :=
  Game.insert { board := .empty }

inductive MoveError where
  | noSuchGame
  | gameOver
  | notYourTurn
  | squareTaken

/-- Which part of the rule a move breaks. It only picks the error; `require` does the checking. -/
def MoveError.of (board : Board) (move : Move) : MoveError :=
  if board.status ∈ [.xWon, .oWon, .draw] then .gameOver
  else if board.status ≠ move.player.toMove then .notYourTurn
  else .squareTaken

def move (game : Ref Game) (player : Player) (square : Square) : Op MoveError Status := do
  let some g ← Game.find game | throw .noSuchGame
  let m : Move := ⟨player, square⟩
  let ⟨valid⟩ ← require (g.board.ValidMove m) (MoveError.of g.board m)
  let board := g.board.play m valid
  Game.update g { board }
  return board.status

structure GameView where
  board  : Board
  status : Status

inductive GetGameError where
  | noSuchGame

def getGame (game : Ref Game) : ReadOp GetGameError GameView := do
  let some g ← Game.find game | throw .noSuchGame
  return { board := g.board, status := g.board.status }

def api : Api := [
  post "/games"              newGame,
  post "/games/:game/moves"  move,
  get  "/games/:game"        getGame
]
import LeanApi.Core.Flow

/-! A source normal form for the actual LeanAPI `Flow`, with its original typed requests
and values. The normalization theorem is independent of the Meta reifier and storage backend. -/
namespace Derive.Source
open LeanApi.Core

inductive Normal (resources : Resources) (kind : Contract.OperationKind) (Scope Error Result : Type) : Type 1 where
  | done (value : Result)
  | failed (error : Error)
  | request {Value : Type} (request : RequestF resources Scope kind Value)
      (next : Value → Normal resources kind Scope Error Result)
  | checked (proposition : Prop) (decision : Decidable proposition) (error : Error)
      (next : PLift proposition → Normal resources kind Scope Error Result)

def Normal.bind (source : Normal r k s e α) (next : α → Normal r k s e β) : Normal r k s e β :=
  match source with
  | .done value => next value
  | .failed error => .failed error
  | .request req continuation => .request req (fun value => (continuation value).bind next)
  | .checked p decision error continuation => .checked p decision error (fun value => (continuation value).bind next)

def normalize : FlowF r k s e α → Normal r k s e α
  | .pure value => .done value
  | .fail error => .failed error
  | .request req => .request req Normal.done
  | .bind source next => (normalize source).bind (fun value => normalize (next value))
  | .check p decision error => .checked p decision error Normal.done

def Normal.run {m : Type → Type u} [Monad m] (algebra : Algebra m k s r) :
    Normal r k s e α → m (Except e α)
  | .done value => pure (.ok value)
  | .failed error => pure (.error error)
  | .request req next => do
    let value ← algebra.request req
    (next value).run algebra
  | .checked _ decision error next => match decision with
    | .isTrue proof => (next ⟨proof⟩).run algebra
    | .isFalse _ => pure (.error error)

theorem Normal.run_bind {m : Type → Type u} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
    (algebra : Algebra m k s r) (source : Normal r k s e α) (next : α → Normal r k s e β) :
    (source.bind next).run algebra = (do
      match ← source.run algebra with
      | .error error => pure (.error error)
      | .ok value => (next value).run algebra) := by
  induction source with
  | done value | failed error => simp [Normal.bind, Normal.run]
  | request request continuation ih =>
    simp only [Normal.bind, Normal.run, ih, bind_assoc]
  | checked p decision error next ih => cases decision <;> simp [Normal.bind, Normal.run, ih]

/-- The starting point is LeanAPI's actual `Flow.run`, for every lawful backend monad,
including framework failures and state. No reifier-correctness assumption occurs here. -/
theorem normalize_sound {m : Type → Type u} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
    (algebra : Algebra m k s r) (source : FlowF r k s e α) :
    (normalize source).run algebra = Flow.run algebra source := by
  induction source with
  | pure value | fail error => rfl
  | request request => simp [normalize, Normal.run, Flow.run]
  | bind source next ihs ihn => simp only [normalize, Normal.run_bind, ihs, ihn, Flow.run]; rfl
  | check proposition decision error => cases decision <;> rfl

def Normal.toFlow : Normal r k s e α → FlowF r k s e α
  | .done value => .pure value
  | .failed error => .fail error
  | .request req next => .bind (.request req) (fun value => (next value).toFlow)
  | .checked p decision error next => .bind (.check p decision error) (fun value => (next value).toFlow)

theorem Normal.toFlow_sound {m : Type → Type u} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
    (algebra : Algebra m k s r) (source : Normal r k s e α) :
    Flow.run algebra source.toFlow = source.run algebra := by
  induction source with
  | done value | failed error => rfl
  | request req next ih => simp [Normal.toFlow, Flow.run, Normal.run, ih]
  | checked p decision error next ih => cases decision <;> simp [Normal.toFlow, Flow.run, Normal.run, ih]

structure Normalized (source : FlowF r k s e α) where
  tree : Normal r k s e α
  preserves : ∀ {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (algebra : Algebra m k s r),
    tree.run algebra = Flow.run algebra source

def certify (source : FlowF r k s e α) : Normalized source :=
  ⟨normalize source, fun algebra => normalize_sound algebra source⟩

theorem Normalized.preserves_flow (source : FlowF r k s e α) (certificate : Normalized source)
    {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (algebra : Algebra m k s r) :
    Flow.run algebra certificate.tree.toFlow = Flow.run algebra source := by
  rw [Normal.toFlow_sound, certificate.preserves]

    let type ← inferType source
    let code ← encoding type
    let actual ← mkAppM ``IR.evalRows #[
      ← mkAppM ``Source.World.variables #[context.world],
      ← mkAppM ``Source.World.sources #[context.world],
      ← mkAppM ``Source.World.rows #[context.world], quoteIR ir]
    withLocalDeclD `source_scalar_relation (← mkEq actual (mkApp code.code source)) fun proof => do
      let certificate := mkAppN (mkConst ``Source.ScalarTerm.mk)
        #[type, context.world, code.code, source, quoteIR ir, proof]
      next { context with bindings := context.bindings.push ⟨source, ir, certificate⟩ } (hypotheses.push proof)

def view (decode : NativeStore → LogicalStore) (w : Machine NativeStore) : Machine LogicalStore :=

    native.load store entity id = logical.load (decode store) entity id
  append : ∀ store owner source values,
    (native.append store owner source values).map decode = logical.append (decode store) owner source values
  insert : ∀ store entity value,

of these obligations; framework failures are observed as exactly the same error. -/
structure Contract (decode : NativeStore → LogicalStore)
    (logical : StorageAlgebra LogicalStore) (native : StorageAlgebra NativeStore) : Prop where
  load : ∀ store entity id,
    native.load store entity id = logical.load (decode store) entity id
  append : ∀ store owner source values,
    (native.append store owner source values).map decode = logical.append (decode store) owner source values
  insert : ∀ store entity value,
    (native.insert store entity value).map (fun (id, state) => (id, decode state)) =
      logical.insert (decode store) entity value

@[simp] theorem view_bind (decode : τ → σ) (w : Machine τ) (name : String) (value : Int) :
    view decode (bindVariable w name value) = bindVariable (view decode w) name value := rfl

private theorem view_columns (decode : τ → σ) (fields : IR.Row) (row : Nat) : ∀ w : Machine τ,
    view decode (fields.foldl (fun state (field, value) => bindVariable state s!"row{row}.{field}" value) w) =
      fields.foldl (fun state (field, value) => bindVariable state s!"row{row}.{field}" value) (view decode w) := by
  induction fields with
  | nil => intro w; rfl
  | cons field rest ih => intro w; simpa only [List.foldl_cons, view_bind] using ih (bindVariable w s!"row{row}.{field.1}" field.2)

@[simp] theorem view_load (decode : τ → σ) (w : Machine τ) (row : Nat) (entity : Lean.Name)
    (id : Int) (sources : Array Nat) (loaded : Loaded) :
    view decode (afterLoad w row entity id sources loaded) =
      afterLoad (view decode w) row entity id sources loaded := by
  unfold afterLoad
  have columns := view_columns decode loaded.columns row w
  cases h : loaded.columns.foldl (fun state (field, value) => bindVariable state s!"row{row}.{field}" value) w
  simp only [h, view] at columns
  simp only [view]
  rw [← columns]
  rfl

@[simp] theorem scalar_view (decode : τ → σ) (w : Machine τ) :
    sourceScalar (view decode w) = sourceScalar w := rfl

/-- Refinement under individual call contracts, including every branch, failure and returned
value. The native store need not have the same representation as the logical store. -/
theorem run_refines (decode : τ → σ) (logical : StorageAlgebra σ) (native : StorageAlgebra τ)
    (contract : Contract decode logical native) (p : Prog) : ∀ w,
    viewResult decode (run sourceScalar native p w) = run sourceScalar logical p (view decode w) := by
  induction p with
  | ret m | fail m => intro w; rfl
  | ite condition yes no ihy ihn =>
    intro w
    simp only [run, scalar_view]
    by_cases yes : (sourceScalar w condition != 0) = true
    · simpa [yes] using ihy w
    · simpa [yes] using ihn w
  | load row entity id sources next ih =>
    intro w
    simp only [run, scalar_view, view_store]
    rw [← contract.load w.store entity (sourceScalar w id)]
    cases outcome : native.load w.store entity (sourceScalar w id) with
    | error error => rfl
    | ok loaded =>
      simpa only [Bind.bind, Except.bind, view_load] using ih (afterLoad w row entity (sourceScalar w id) sources loaded)
  | append row source values next ih =>
    intro w
    simp only [run, scalar_view, view_store, view_owners, view_variables, view_sources]
    rw [← contract.append w.store (w.owners row) source (values.map (MeaningF.map (sourceScalar w)))]
    cases outcome : native.append w.store (w.owners row) source (values.map (MeaningF.map (sourceScalar w))) with
    | error error => rfl
    | ok store => simpa only [Bind.bind, Except.bind, Except.map, view] using ih { w with store }
  | insert n entity value next ih =>
    intro w
    simp only [run, scalar_view, view_store, view_owners, view_variables, view_sources]
    rw [← contract.insert w.store entity (value.map (sourceScalar w))]
    cases outcome : native.insert w.store entity (value.map (sourceScalar w)) with
    | error error => rfl
    | ok pair =>
      rcases pair with ⟨id, store⟩
      simpa only [Bind.bind, Except.bind, Except.map, view, bindVariable] using ih (bindVariable { w with store } s!"insert{n}.id" id)

/-- The compiler theorem composed with runtime representation refinement. -/
theorem compiled_refines (decode : τ → σ) (logical : StorageAlgebra σ) (native : StorageAlgebra τ)
    (contract : Contract decode logical native) (p : Prog) (w : Machine τ) :
    viewResult decode (run targetScalar native (compile p) w) = run sourceScalar logical p (view decode w) := by
  rw [compile_sound]
  exact run_refines decode logical native contract p w

theorem view_atomic (decode : τ → σ) (initial : Machine τ) (result : Result τ) :
    viewResult decode (atomic initial result) = atomic (view decode initial) (viewResult decode result) := by
  cases result with
  | error error => rfl
  | ok pair => rcases pair with ⟨result, state⟩; cases result <;> rfl

theorem compiled_atomic_refines (decode : τ → σ) (logical : StorageAlgebra σ) (native : StorageAlgebra τ)
    (contract : Contract decode logical native) (p : Prog) (w : Machine τ) :
    viewResult decode (atomic w (run targetScalar native (compile p) w)) =
      atomic (view decode w) (run sourceScalar logical p (view decode w)) := by
  rw [view_atomic, compiled_refines decode logical native contract]

end Derive.Runtime
